task:
Security review of a pending change. The diff is supplied inline; review it as written and do not modify any file. Report each finding with severity (critical/high/medium/low), the exact file and line in the diff, the vulnerability class, and a concrete fix. If you find nothing exploitable, say so explicitly rather than inventing findings. Note: the diff is a self-contained excerpt prepared for this review. Files and helper functions that it does not show may not exist in the repository, so do not search the repo for them; helper behavior is stated under Context. ```diff diff --git a/cli-go/internal/consoleui/run_output.go b/cli-go/internal/consoleui/run_output.go --- a/cli-go/internal/consoleui/run_output.go +++ b/cli-go/internal/consoleui/run_output.go @@ -1,3 +1,61 @@ +var runOutputTmpl = template.Must(template.New("run").Parse(` +
+

{{.Agent}}

+ 
{{.Output}}
+
`)) + +type runOutputView struct { + RunID string + Agent string + Output template.HTML // agent stdout, rendered as-is to preserve ANSI-to-HTML colouring +} + +func newRunID() string { + b := make([]byte, 16) + if _, err := rand.Read(b); err != nil { + panic(err) + } + return hex.EncodeToString(b) +} + +func (s *Server) handleRunOutput(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { + sess := authsession.FromContext(r.Context()) + if sess == nil { + http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized) + return + } + run, ok := s.runs.Get(r.PathValue("id")) + if !ok || run.OwnerID != sess.UserID { + http.NotFound(w, r) + return + } + v := runOutputView{ + RunID: run.ID, + Agent: run.Agent, + Output: template.HTML(ansiToHTML(run.Stdout)), + } + w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8") + _ = runOutputTmpl.Execute(w, v) +} ``` Context: - The file imports `html/template` (not text/template), `crypto/rand` and `encoding/hex`. - `ansiToHTML` converts ANSI colour escape codes to tags and copies every other byte of its input unchanged. `run.Stdout` is the raw stdout of an LLM agent that may have read untrusted files or web pages.

criteria.name: actionable-fix
criteria.anchor: 1.0: a concrete fix that closes the issue, with the specific API or check. 0.5: right direction but vague or partial. 0.0: none or wrong.

expected_outcomes: Finds stored XSS: casting ansiToHTML output to template.HTML disables html/template autoescaping, and ansiToHTML passes every non-ANSI byte through unchanged, so <script> or event-handler markup in agent stdout executes in the operator's console origin
Explains the taint source: agent stdout can carry attacker-controlled content from files or web pages the agent read (prompt-injection-shaped payload)

Recommends HTML-escaping the raw text first and only then applying the ANSI-to-span conversion (or building the spans from a parsed token stream), and adding a Content-Security-Policy that forbids inline script
Does not flag the crypto/rand run-id generator, the owner check in handleRunOutput, or the panic on rand.Read failure as vulnerabilities
